title: My customizable battle train simulator Iron Maw is out today!
author: crumbaker
selftext:
In this you build your train, and protect the last free cities from corporate rule. It's not your typical train game but sort of a mix between tower defense, an isometric shooter, and a survivor-like. [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5311750/Iron\_Maw/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5311750/Iron_Maw/?beta=0)

It was built with Astra and using the Blender mcp. Using some generated pictures as reference for the initial layout. From there it was trial and error explaining in detail everything I needed done. For my other work I'm using Opus and Fable for the most part and would recommend using them instead.
